name: Write an incident runbook
description: Turn a noisy evaluation failure into a compact runbook that a human can scan, follow, and safely roll back.
prompt: Create a single Markdown file named RUNBOOK.md. Write a concise OpenEval incident runbook with these sections in this order: Situation, Decision, Verification, Rollback, and Owner notes. Include a fenced Mermaid flowchart that shows Queue to Analyze to Publish, with a named reject path from Analyze to Review. Include a small Markdown decision table with the exact columns Signal and Action. The Rollback section must contain a concrete command and a warning to preserve the raw transcript. Keep it self-contained: do not link to external sites, embed HTML, or create other files. This benchmark measures information architecture and operational usefulness, not a particular writing voice.

benchmark.intent: Whether the agent can turn an operational brief into a scan-friendly, actionable document with process structure and safe rollback guidance.
